findings.evidence: `<form>` wrapping `<input id="project-settings-name-input">` and `<button id="project-settings-save-btn" type="submit">Save</button>` with no `action` attribute and no corresponding confirmation state

findings.violation: Clicking Save has no defined destination or feedback - unlike every other flow in the document (invite, archive, notifications all have a visible next/confirmation step), this one is a dead end.

findings.fix: Add visible button text (e.g., "Duplicate") and wire it to an actual destination or action, mirroring how other controls in the mockup link somewhere.
findings.violation: The button has no visible text label (only an aria-label) and no href/action, so sighted users see an unlabeled blank control that does nothing when activated.
